title: Information-theoretic receding-horizon active learning of nonlinear dynamical systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.36712v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurately learning nonlinear dynamics from a finite-duration experiment requires the efficient collection of informative data. We address this challenge for stochastic controlled nonlinear dynamical systems whose state is observed along a single trajectory. Our goal is to reconstruct the unknown controlled state-increment map over a prescribed compact subset of state-input space. We construct a parametric estimator of the map using fixed nonlinear features, so that the model is nonlinear in the state and input, but linear in the unknown parameters. A Gaussian prior over the parameters yields recursive Bayesian posterior updates as data stream in, enabling online quantification of predictive uncertainty in the reconstructed dynamics over the target set. We formulate an optimal adaptive-design problem over an information state, using a prediction-oriented acquisition criterion based on the mean marginal mutual information between candid

translated_title: 基于信息论的滚动时域非线性动力系统主动学习
translated_abstract: 从有限时长的实验中准确学习非线性动力学，需要高效地收集富含信息的数据。我们针对随机受控非线性动力系统来解决这一挑战，该系统的状态沿单条轨迹被观测。我们的目标是在状态-输入空间的一个指定紧子集上重构未知的受控状态增量映射。我们利用固定的非线性特征构建该映射的参数化估计器，使得模型在状态和输入上是非线性的，但在未知参数上是线性的。对参数施加高斯先验，随着数据流的到来产生递归的贝叶斯后验更新，从而能够在线量化目标集上所重构动力学的预测不确定性。我们在信息状态上构建了一个最优自适应设计问题，采用一种面向预测的采集准则，该准则基于候选（输入）之间的平均边际互信息……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于信息论的滚动时域主动学习方法，通过线性于参数的非线性特征模型结合贝叶斯后验更新实现在线不确定性量化，并利用平均边际互信息采集准则自适应地规划实验，从而从单条轨迹的有限时长实验中高效重构随机受控非线性动力系统。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an information-theoretic receding-horizon active learning approach that combines a nonlinear-feature, parameter-linear model with recursive Bayesian uncertainty quantification and a mean marginal mutual information acquisition criterion, enabling efficient reconstruction of stochastic controlled nonlinear dynamical systems from single-trajectory, finite-duration experiments.
